MappingPage / canvas-domain              baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
|-- entry: MappingPocPage(services) -> MappingWorkspacePage
|-- supplied MappingServices
|   |-- diagrams: DiagramService                                      -> [G]
|   |-- canvasHistory: CanvasHistoryService                           -> [E]
|   `-- workspaceStorage? -> storage; fallback: new WorkspaceStorage
|-- workspace: CanvasWorkspace                         owns session lifetimes
|   |-- drafts[documentId]: CanvasDraft
|   |   |-- name / savedName / savedScene / savedEdges? / revisionId
|   |   |-- representationId? / hidden? / busy / newerRevision?
|   |   |-- viewport? / focusBox? / reloadKey?
|   |   `-- session: CanvasSession
|   |       |-- controller: MappingDocumentController                 -> [R]
|   |       |-- document store       { document }        read-only mirror
|   |       |-- presentation store   { display, diagramViews }
|   |       |-- selection / controls stores
|   |       |-- geometry store       { endpointBounds, cell, version }
|   |       |-- status store         isDirty / sceneDirty / canUndo / canRedo
|   |       `-- onCommit             canvasRevisionId changed -> persist(id)
|   |-- controllers[documentId]      references each session.controller
|   |-- store / changes / dirtyScenes                    read-only store APIs
|   `-- setDrafts / copyDocument / dispose               manage session lifetime
|-- viewState: SourcePaneViewState                       live view state
|   |-- entries[documentId][paneId]   sourceId? / sourceFile / scroll / reader
|   |-- cameras[documentId]: CanvasTransform
|   `-- captureDisplay / captureCamera                  sampled on capture
|-- storage: WorkspaceStorage                           durable I/O -> [E]
|   |-- records?: RecordStorage                         cache + queued changes
|   `-- worker?: Worker                                load / write / project
|-- persistence: WorkspacePersistence                   sibling adapter -> [E]
|   `-- workspace.onPersist + viewState.subscribe -> incremental records
|-- diagramEdits: DiagramEditCoordinator                 composer / edit client
|-- revisionReceiver: DiagramRevisionReceiver            agent revision apply
|-- useAgentCanvasBridge                                command/reply + live -> [D]
|-- page state                                          activeId / transfers[]
|   `-- pendingTransfer / busy flags / catalog snapshot / search / changeMode
|-- mounted document view
|   `-- DraggableDiagramCanvas -> MappingPocSelectionCanvas(session)
|-- capture(): MappingWorkspaceSnapshot                  returned data only
|   |-- schemaVersion: 3 / projectId / activeDocumentId? / transfers?
|   `-- documents[]: MappingDocumentSnapshot
|       |-- representationId       workspace document key
|       |-- savedRepresentationId? / name / revisionId / hidden?
|       |-- savedName / savedScene / savedEdges?
|       |-- document: MappingGridDocument                current scene + edges
|       |-- canvas: MappingCanvasState                   captured display scroll
|       |-- history: CanvasHistoryRecord                 controller.exportHistory()
|       `-- viewport?: CanvasTransform                  captured camera
|-- workspaceAction('export')                            serializeWorkspace(capture())
|-- workspaceAction('save')                              sync records; storage.flush()
|-- restore / import                                    rebuild sessions + viewState
|-- save()                                              saveMappingProjectDiagram
|   `-- captured document + history -> acknowledgement updates saved baseline
|-- transfer / workspace undo-redo                      prepare; save; install -> [E]
`-- [R] MappingDocumentController                    same session-owned controller
    |-- diagrams / historyService                           supplied services [G] / [E]
    |-- context: CanvasEditingContext                       opaque { contextId } handle
    |-- snapshot: ControllerSnapshot
    |   |-- contextId / canvasRevisionId / version / canUndo / canRedo
    |   |-- cell? { width, height } / endpointBounds?
    |   |-- document: MappingGridDocument
    |   |   |-- scene: LineGridScene                         contents + root -> [A]
    |   |   |-- edges[]: DiagramConnection                   authoritative connections
    |   |   |-- sections[contentId]: MappingPocASection[]
    |   |   `-- jumps?: CanvasJump[]
    |   `-- canvas: MappingCanvasState
    |       |-- selection.items[]: SelectionItem             ordered membership
    |       |   |-- id / displayNodeId                       grid instance reference
    |       |   `-- region?                                 absent = whole diagram
    |       |       |-- sourceContentId / sourceRevisionId? / sourceAscii
    |       |       `-- rect / selectedIds[]                captured selection
    |       |-- diagramViews?[displayNodeId]
    |       |   `-- contentRevisionId / collapsedContentNodeIds[]
    |       |-- display: DisplayState                       floating ownership tree
    |       |   `-- rootIds[] / nodes[id]: FloatingPane      variants -> [C]
    |       `-- controls: MappingControls
    |           |-- activeBoxId / selectionFocusId / activeThreadId
    |           `-- surfaces[id]: SelectionSurfaceState
    |               `-- actions / presentation / projection / prompt / ask / status
    |-- applyUpdate / select / updateCanvas / undo / reset                  -> [D]
    `-- nodes(): CanvasDisplayNode[]                        computed read-only registry
        |-- shared: id / version / childIds[] / expansion
        |-- collapsible: self / subtrees[]
        |   `-- contentNodeId / label / line / branchColumn / visibleRow? / expansion
        |-- layout: 'grid'                                   id = grid:<boxId>
        |   |-- kind: 'diagram' | 'group' / boxId
        |   |-- geometry: units 'cells'; bounds column / row / columns / rows
        |   `-- content? / contentNodes? / diagram?          from scene contents [B]
        `-- layout: 'floating'                               id = floating:<id>
            |-- kind: FloatingBox.kind / value: FloatingBox  stored panes or drawn arrow
            |-- geometry: units 'pixels'; position / bounds / coordinateSpace
            `-- placement: FloatingPlacement                derived alternatives
                |-- connection     edgeId                   document.edges -> drawEdge
                |-- grid-region    gridBoxId / contentId / rect / sourceAscii
                |-- parent         ownerId                  automatic child projection
                |-- conversation   canvasAnchor / presentation
                `-- stored         coordinateSpace          canvas | viewport
